profile.title: Model-guided TCP handshake probes for dMAP
profile.semantics: Compositional literal-binding colored Petri net; XML arcs and guards are the executable source.
profile.ordinary_progress: Fixed valid passive setup, ACK/FIN teardown variants, application close and normalized TIME_WAIT expiry.
limitations: Conservative symbolic TCP profile, not a pinned complete Linux kernel clone.
Passive server only; no server-initiated SYN or simultaneous active open.
Two total incarnation identities and two four-tuples; fresh disjoint sequence windows.
No loss, options, PAWS, backlog, SYN cookies, or segmentation/reassembly.
Ahead sequence representative leaves a 32768-byte gap; 100-byte readout never fills it; arbitrary out-of-order queue completion excluded.
Application close is an explicit modeled environment event; ACK/challenge rate limits assumed permit modeled reply.
TIME_WAIT fast reuse omitted; protected RST handling; wait units are abstract.
No DPI state/outcomes are modeled or measured.
Response ordering is serialized by ATTACKER_READY; one mandatory reply at a time.
No native GreatSPN parser/runtime executed in this environment.
